Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail

Interface MailService

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ImapSmtpMailService
public interface MailService extends AutoCloseable
The mail backend contract both desktops program against. One instance is bound to one MailAccount by connect(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail.MailAccount, java.lang.String); the real implementation is ImapSmtpMailService (Jakarta Mail), and the tests substitute an in-memory fake so the UI and the MailSessionManager can be exercised headlessly without a server.

Every method throws MailBackendException rather than a Jakarta Mail type, so no caller needs the mail API on its own import list.
